rules: Original V5 mechanism and fixed signal-policy target retained for all latent comparisons
New evidence regime: independent, representative, fully audited predecision-state trajectories including signals, actions and rewards
Finite-horizon optimal signal-history policy learned from one independent audited pilot, then the whole tree frozen before evaluation
Policy sees current/past signals and own actions; rewards settle after the policy horizon and audited states are never policy inputs
Row-count MLE and trajectory influence covariance estimate initial distribution, emissions, transitions and rewards jointly; no pseudocount at evaluation
Missing state/action/transition support yields unavailable inference; retain every failure
Latent follow-up is a distinct larger observational sample regime, not a replacement for the retained N600 evidence
Audit selection and true label invariance are scientific assumptions; a distorted-label adverse run is descriptive sensitivity
